content:
The exhibition space at the Apple Park Visitor Center in Cupertino has been temporarily closed.

The company has not yet revealed the nature of the improvements, but the current use of the space does seem quite inefficient...

The closed area currently houses a physical model of the Apple Park campus, which visitors can explore via iPad using augmented reality. While the concept is interesting, the model takes up a great deal of space in the store with relatively limited benefit.

The construction was spotted by the X account Retail Archive.

A brief notice about the work has been posted on Apple's website.

What do you think the company has planned? Share your guesses in the comments.
